parameters.gold: σ Daily transition rate E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
parameters.extracted: σ Daily rate of progression through exposed stages (E1→E2 and E2→I1).

parameters.gold: γ Daily transition rate I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
parameters.extracted: γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages (I1→I2 and I2→R).

parameters: β Transmission rate parameter in force of infection λ(t)=β I(t)/N (frequency-dependent).
λ(t) Force of infection at time t (per-susceptible infection hazard).
δt Discrete-time step used in the paper (quarter of a day).
π Initial susceptibility: proportion of population initially susceptible (S(0)=πN).
λ₀ Initial infection rate / initial force of infection at t=0 (EGR parametrization).
ψ Exponential growth rate (EGR) at epidemic start (used for re-parameterization).
N Population size for the season (fixed within season).
pICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection (observation/severity link).
μICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time).
σ²ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time).
η Negative binomial over-dispersion for weekly ICU/HDU counts.
R₀ Basic reproduction number (derived; depends on ψ, σ, γ under EGR parametrization).
Rₙ Effective reproduction number in partially susceptible population (function of π and ψ).
TAR Total attack rate over the season (probability a susceptible individual is infected).
I₀ Initial total infectious individuals (derived quantity in EGR parametrization).
β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (homogeneous mixing)
